item.title: Her 911 Call Was Not Enough To Save Denise Amber Lee
item.description: Denise Amber Lee was abducted from her Florida home in 2008 and managed to call 911 from her captor’s phone. Other witnesses also called for help, but communication failures delayed the response. Michael King was convicted of her murder and executed in March 2026.

item.title: Why The Lindsay Clancy Case Is Being Compared To Andrea Yates
item.description: Lindsay Clancy’s 2026 murder trial revived comparisons to Andrea Yates, who killed her five children in 2001 and was later found not guilty by reason of insanity. Clancy’s defense likewise argued that postpartum psychosis left her not criminally responsible. Her first trial ended in a mistrial in September 2026 after jurors deadlocked.

item.title: A 55-Year-Old Murder Conviction Was Later Overturned
item.description: Seven-year-old Maria Ridulph disappeared from Sycamore, Illinois, in 1957. Decades later, Jack McCullough was convicted of her murder, partly after renewed witness testimony and alleged jailhouse admissions. But a later review uncovered evidence supporting his alibi, and his conviction was vacated in 2016.
